title: 第5章 林萧第6章 抢女主灭狮王天命之子当狗揍
lines: 心念一动，三个橙色宝箱就全都被顾云打开。
【巅峰丹：系统出品必属精品，突破合体境后服用，可使宿主直接拥有神体，无需打磨熬炼，且品质至高】
【机缘掠夺卡：能凭空获得一件任意主角的机缘，无副作用，收获全看脸】
【天命转移光环（白）：与天命之子相隔不超过十万里时，将会每日降低天命之子一点天命值】
竟然开出了一个光环。
顾云心中微微有些惊喜，可是很快他就像被泼了一盆冷水。
“白色的光环，有点儿鸡肋。”
顾云有些嫌弃，一个橙色宝箱开出来一个白色的光环，自己的运气又没有那么好了。
当然也够用了，十万里的范围，大概能覆盖五分之一个苍玄界。
正好，这两个主角暂时都在影响范围内。
天命主角有各自的天命值，这些天命值乃是顾云打开大罗道塔的钥匙。
将天命之子提前斩杀，不会有惩罚，但是会导致天命值被天道回收，从而诞生新的天命之子，且后出现的天命之子一定会更强。
目前自己的反派光环只不过是橙色的，其上还有三个等级，因此这个世间绝对有能够威胁自己的天命之子存在，顾云很是清楚这一点，虽为反派，身份地位不凡，但终究是反派，是诸多天命的垫脚石，此等命运，顾云自是不会遵从。
苍玄界的这两个韭菜，顾云必须彻底割掉，打开大罗道塔的第一层，提升自己，之后才能更有把握。
身为反派，一定要稳，千万不能浪，绝不能给气运之子任何翻盘的机会。
机缘掠夺卡，顾云也不打算现在使用，这玩意儿可是好东西，万一让自己随机到了林萧或者唐山的机缘，那就不好了，两人的一切都已经被自己拿捏在手中了。
最好是先把这两个家伙玩死之后再使用，这样的话，不仅能得到一份天命之子的机缘，还能将隐藏的敌人揪出来.
日上三竿。
影儿终于苏醒，她略带着娇羞和恐惧看向顾云，难怪……难怪就连那位女帝陛下都……
她的心里还是有些颤抖不安，她和顾云之间身份悬殊，即便有了些许羁绊，但是她根本就不够资格嫁给顾云。
只有顾云不嫌弃她，愿意一直将她留在身边，她才有活下去的希望。
而且……身为一个女人，她的内心深处还是渴望着……渴望着这个夺走了她一切的男人能有那么一点点在乎她，一点点就够了。
“醒了？过来。”顾云伸开手，直接毫不客气的将影儿搂进怀中。
“少、少主，天亮了，影儿不该继续耽误少爷的要事。”
“没事儿，只要你以后乖乖听话，无论何时你都可以随时出现在我身边，不用继续躲藏在阴影中，你这一辈子都可以是我的贴身侍卫！专属的，就算是师尊要把你要回去，我都不让。”顾云嘴角勾动着淡淡的笑意。
“嗯……影儿明白了。”影儿脸上染上烟霞，送上自己美妙的香唇。
顾云也给予了回应。
影儿心中无比的感动，身为死士她向来要求的不多，能活下来就已经是女帝陛下最大的赏赐了，她还需要求些什么呢？
然而少主给予了她足够的尊重和爱护，这一刻，她已经下定了决心，自己这一辈子永远都只属于少主一人！
紫云州，紫云山脉。
顾云出现在了密林之上，他缓缓悬浮于半空之中，眸光微微望向远方。
他的身上有一层薄薄的黑气环绕。
正是影儿。
影儿表示之后要以这种方式保护顾云，哪怕是遇到了来不及躲闪的攻击，她也会是顾云的第一道防线。
“少主，前方好像有一个炼虚境人类在和一名炼虚境大妖进行战斗。”
影儿的神识极为灵敏，很快就发现了前方的异常。
眼前的天空，青紫二色交织，狂风涌动，怒雷激荡，弥漫着两股截然不同的气息。
林萧此时正身处紫云山脉中进行历练，而这里，也正是他的一次机缘。
紫云宗，作为一个强大的霸主势力，其宗主风云韵与紫雷狂狮大战之中受了伤，这狮王也是一个不正经的货色，最终的攻击之中夹杂了几缕狂暴真意，对紫雷狂狮来说，这种剂量正好可以使其战力飙升。
但是对人类修士来说，那就是……，某种不可言说的妙药。
content_en:
With a thought, all three orange treasure boxes were opened by Gu Yun.
[Peak Pill: The product produced by the system must be of high quality. If taken after breaking through the Fusion Realm, the host can directly possess the divine body without polishing and tempering, and the quality is of the highest quality]
[Opportunity plunder card: you can get an opportunity of any protagonist out of thin air, no side effects, the harvest depends on your face]
[Destiny Transfer Halo (White): When the distance between you and the Son of Destiny is not more than 100,000 miles, the Son of Destiny's destiny value will be reduced by one point every day]
It actually opened a halo.
Gu Yun was slightly surprised, but soon he felt like a bucket of cold water had been poured on him.
"The white halo is a bit tasteless."
Gu Yun was a little disgusted. An orange treasure box opened with a white halo, and his luck was not that good.
Of course it is enough. The range of one hundred thousand miles can cover about one-fifth of the Cangxuan Realm.
It just so happens that these two protagonists are within the scope of influence for the time being.
The destiny protagonists have their own destiny values, and these destiny values ​​are Gu Yun's key to opening the Daluo Tao Tower.
There will be no penalty for killing the Son of Destiny in advance, but it will cause the Destiny Value to be recovered by Heaven, thus giving birth to a new Son of Destiny, and the Son of Destiny that appears later will definitely be stronger.
At present, his villain aura is only orange, and there are three levels above it, so there are definitely children of destiny who can threaten him in this world. Gu Yun knows this very well. Although he is a villain and has an extraordinary status, he is still a villain and a stepping stone for many destiny. Gu Yun will not obey such a fate.
Gu Yun must completely cut off these two leeks in the Cangxuan Realm, open the first level of the Daluo Tao Tower, and improve himself, so that he can be more confident in the future.
As a villain, you must be steady, must not be reckless, and must not give the son of luck any chance to make a comeback.
Gu Yun doesn't plan to use the Opportunity Loot Card now. This thing is a good thing. It would be bad if he randomly encounters Lin Xiao or Tangshan. Everything about the two of them is already in his hands.
It's best to kill these two guys before using them. In this case, you can not only get a chance to be the Destined Child, but also uncover the hidden enemies.
Three poles in the sun.
Ying'er finally woke up. She looked at Gu Yun with a little shyness and fear. No wonder...no wonder even the Empress...
She still felt a little trembling and uneasy in her heart. There was a huge disparity in status between her and Gu Yun. Even though they had some bond, she was not qualified to marry Gu Yun at all.
Only if Gu Yun doesn't dislike her and is willing to keep her by his side can she have hope of living.
And...as a woman, deep down in her heart she still longs...for this man who took everything away from her to care about her just a little bit, and just a little bit is enough.
"Are you awake? Come here." Gu Yun stretched out his hand and pulled Ying'er into his arms unceremoniously.
"Young Master, it's dawn, Ying'er shouldn't continue to delay the young master's important matters."
"It's okay. As long as you are obedient from now on, you can appear by my side at any time. You don't have to hide in the shadows anymore. You can be my personal bodyguard for the rest of your life! It's yours. Even if the master wants to take you back, I won't let you go." Gu Yun's lips twitched with a faint smile.
"Well... Ying'er understands." Ying'er's face was stained with haze, and she presented her beautiful lips.
Gu Yun also responded.
Ying'er was extremely moved in her heart. As a dead soldier, she never asked for much. Being able to survive was already the greatest reward from Her Majesty the Empress. What else did she need to ask for?
However, the young master gave her enough respect and love. At this moment, she had made up her mind that she would always belong to the young master alone in her life!
…
Ziyun Prefecture, Ziyun Mountains.
Gu Yun appeared above the dense forest. He slowly floated in the air, his eyes slightly looking into the distance.
There was a thin layer of black energy surrounding his body.
It's Ying'er.
Ying'er said that she would protect Gu Yun in this way in the future. Even if she encountered an attack that was too late to dodge, she would be Gu Yun's first line of defense.
"Young Master, there seems to be a Void Refining Realm human being fighting a Void Refining Realm demon ahead."
Ying'er's consciousness was extremely sensitive and he quickly discovered the anomaly ahead.
The sky in front of him was intertwined with blue and purple, with strong winds surging and thunder thundering, filled with two completely different atmospheres.
Lin Xiao was currently practicing in the Ziyun Mountains, and this was his opportunity.
Ziyun Sect, as a powerful overlord force, its sect leader Fengyun Yun was injured in the battle with the Purple Thunder Crazy Lion. This lion king was also an unruly guy. The final attack contained a few strands of violent true meaning. For the Purple Thunder Crazy Lion, this dose was just enough to soar its combat power.
But for human monks, it is..., some kind of indescribable medicine.
title_en: Chapter 5 Lin Xiao Chapter 6 Stealing the heroine and destroying the lion king, the destined son is beaten like a dog
